column2: To ensure that awareness of compliance extends from top managementto each employee,Toyota provides compliance training at careermilestones,such as upon hiring, promotion,and foreign assignment.
Personnel from related specialist divisions hold the BusinessCompliance Seminar every year, providing lectures on laws and regula-tions that employees must understand when carrying out their work.
The Legal Handbook for Corporate Officers is posted on theCompany intranet,and relevant explanations are provided for newlyappointed officers.
Individual training is carried out in the form of e-learning and lecturesprovided in response to individual divisions' needs and requests.
